title: FACTRAIL — Evidence infrastructure for AI agents
short_description: Structured, source-backed evidence for agents: French company verification, beta import assessment, provenance, and integrity-checkable receipts.
scope: Capability discovery, French company verification (company_fr), beta structured import assessment (import), and Evidence receipt retrieval.
limitations: Public beta; inspect factrail_capabilities for actual deployment support.
Trade/import assessment is beta and may be partial or provisional.
No genuine Commission TARIC snapshot is currently installed; Access2Markets is secondary.
No authoritative EU VAT integration or complete authoritative landed-cost chain.
Receipts provide content integrity, not signatures, blockchain records, or proof of universal truth.
